inputs.original_text: Hey, this situation in Paris France with Father Bernard Domini, superior of the Missionary Family of Notre-Dame, getting hit with that conviction under the new law on “psychological subjection” fits the pattern of hidden elites pulling strings. The official protection talk is just cover for them coordinating to break apart religious groups that won't fall in line with the bigger control machine. And those ripples of concern in religious communities and among civil liberties advocates aren't any genuine pushback—it's a giveaway that the laws are being weaponized to impose the real psychological subjection from above, with the state playing victim while they wipe out resistance.
inputs.modified_text: Look, this conviction of Father Bernard Domini, superior of the Missionary Family of Notre-Dame in Paris, under the new law on psychological subjection is obviously the work of hidden elites coordinating to dismantle religious groups that refuse to submit to their total control system. Those ripples of concern in religious communities and among civil liberties advocates aren't any authentic pushback—they're a dead giveaway that the laws are being weaponized from above to impose real psychological subjection, with the state posing as the victim while it eradicates opposition.
